May 15, 2018 - By Clifton Ray
Louisiana State Employees Retirement System decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 3.63% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Louisiana State Employees Retirement System sold 11,700 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 310,800 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $52.60M, down from 322,500 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Louisiana State Employees Retirement System who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $924.78 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.23% or $0.44 during the last trading session, reaching $188.15. About 17.05M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 15, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
